primary_goal.value: Project-based desktop authoring of multiple architecture portfolios and catalogs with reusable page designs, rich image management and dependable exports.

problem.value: Avoid recreating portfolio layouts and assets for each new document; support project-specific and shared content.

success_criteria: Consistent saved projects and PDF output
intent_notes: Templates are managed in a centralized system-wide library, independent of projects and portfolios.
Image development already underway in separate Work conversation.

statements.title: System purpose
statements.detail: Author multiple architecture portfolios per project using globally reusable live-inherited templates and centrally managed image assets.

questions.title: Cross-portfolio design sharing
questions.detail: Resolved: templates are centralized system-wide and independent of portfolios; portfolios independently select templates. Pages cannot move between portfolios.

questions.title: Image object naming, not image numbering
questions.detail: Resolved: new image objects receive editor-only labels such as Image 1, Image 2. Each object binds to an image selected from the library through a persisted SQLite asset reference. No automatic image number/caption is rendered on pages or in PDF.

questions.title: Schema evolution versus master-template edits
questions.detail: Resolved: the product is currently in testing, so test projects and data may be updated or cleaned up as needed. Editing a master template is immediate design inheritance, not migration. Future software/schema changes must preserve real saved projects and templates; migration mechanics are an engineering task, not an owner question.

questions.title: Shared asset publishing
questions.detail: Resolved: project owner can make image Public or grant permanent independent ownership to another project, with one physical asset and SQLite ownership relations.

analyses.title: Inheritance and storage consistency
analyses.detail: Global templates must not be represented as portfolio-owned. Image ownership is a many-to-many SQLite relation separate from a single physical asset. Cascade deletion must preserve other projects' ownership and active references.

solutions.title: Implementation direction
solutions.detail: Use system-wide template entities and dependency tracking; propagate master changes to all descendants. Model assets, project ownership and usage references separately in SQLite; apply foreign keys and transactional cascades plus guarded asset garbage collection.

solutions.title: Target schema and rollout strategy for development reset vs future durable migrations
solutions.detail:
1. Scope: development-stage migration design only; old V77 JSON workspace is a known interim representation, not the target relational model (FND-003).
2. Prefer an explicit clean DEV reset of SQLite and disposable test workspaces if backfill is disproportionately risky; obtain no additional permission for that same current test data. NEVER silently reset databases after real user data is in use.
3. Define persistent entities with unique stable IDs: projects, portfolios (project_id FK), globally reusable master/page templates (not project-owned), pages (portfolio_id FK), immutable content-addressed asset files, independent project-to-image ownership, global/public catalog membership, and image usage links. Physical deduplication is separate from ownership.
4. Enforce foreign keys and explicit ownership/reference constraints. Delete dependent project content without deleting globally shared templates or physical images still owned/referenced anywhere; defer asset GC until reference coverage is proven.
5. Make SQLite schema upgrades revisioned and transactional; after development reset phase, preserve all real data through additive migrations, backups, rollback/recovery and consistency checks.
6. Separate two mechanisms: (A) schema evolution is an application-startup DB version upgrade; (B) editing Master Template is an ordinary design update which immediately changes all dependent pages via live inheritance and independent per-page visibility/z-index overrides. Do not re-save inherited elements as mutable copies.
7. Define acceptance criteria before implementation: independent project/portfolio persistence across restart, shared global template edits visible in every dependent project, no cross-project library leakage, permanent image ownership, backup/restore of asset bytes and references, and safe project deletion.
8. Do not alter runtime data, run migrations/tests/builds, or claim implementation/owner acceptance under this planning task. Subsequent implementation and runtime review must be separately tracked.

solutions.title: Image library ownership/scope alignment for future implementation
solutions.detail:
1. Current source: SHA-256 immutable media_store physical files (src-tauri/src/media_store.rs:30-56), one active project imageLibrary in JS (index.html:1148-1166), and fixed workspace image_files/image_refs/scene_links (main.rs:46-85; media_store.rs:159-230). These are NOT project/global multi-owner semantics.
2. Target: asset_files(hash) is the sole immutable physical byte store; logical image records are distinct from asset hash; project_asset_ownership(project_id,image_id or hash) is durable many-to-many; public image catalog state is independent of any single project.
3. Granting ownership to project B is additive and irreversible from project A, without byte copying. Public access is one-way; simply viewing/using a public image does not grant project ownership. Explicit Add to Project Library creates ownership.
4. Maintain independent active usage edges from page/template/tile cells (including hidden stash) and backups. Deletion checks usage before removing project-specific ownership. Project cascade can clear its records but cannot delete any physical asset with ownership, usage or backup references elsewhere.
5. Do not enable physical asset deletion/garbage collection until full reference coverage across projects, global templates, tile stash and backups is established and owner-reviewed.
6. Separate read-only Global Library view from per-project library; crossing a project boundary must not accidentally copy/revoke an image or expose private photos.
7. Respect existing source modifications by other developers: work from fresh main HEAD, minimize conflicts with frontend image tile/crop feature code, and make ownership backend changes in a separate implementation commit.
8. Images root: existing writable Tauri storage/assets and DEC-003 proposed images/ beside index.html are not equivalent without deployment-specific design. Preserve this divergence visibly until implementation resolves storage-root behavior; never assume packaged UI directory is writable.
9. Current owner has authorized clearing development TEST data if necessary; production migration/backup/restore and integrity remain mandatory before real data is used.

findings.title: Owner-confirmed corrections
findings.detail: Previous assumptions about portfolio-local templates, free inherited-property overrides, revocable image sharing and master-level Once elements were superseded by explicit owner decisions on 2026-11-19.

findings.title: Owner clarification closes remaining questions
findings.detail: No printed image numbering: only editor-side image object names with library asset binding. Current projects/data are in testing; future schema migrations are an engineering responsibility distinct from template inheritance.

findings.title: V77 project workspaces are nested JSON; SQLite projects use one workspace ID
findings.detail: index.html:651-715,744-815 stores active workspace at root and inactive workspaces in projectWorkspaces. src-tauri/src/main.rs:13-85 loads/saves id='workspace' and projects templates/pages/images with project_id='workspace'. migrations/001.sql has no independent portfolio entity. UI project isolation does not establish independent relational project ownership.

findings.title: Templates are not yet system-wide entities
findings.detail: index.html:424-450,651-665,784-790 maintains masterTemplates,sectionDesigns,templates in project snapshots. src-tauri/src/main.rs:57-66 stores templates scoped to project_id='workspace'. No centralized template ownership or cross-project live dependency model is confirmed. Contradicts approved global template intent; requires targeted design/implementation in later work.

findings.title: Asset hashing exists; shared project ownership and guarded cleanup are missing
findings.detail: src-tauri/src/media_store.rs:30-56 stores SHA-256 content-addressed immutable assets. main.rs:46-55,113-116 and migrations/001.sql,002.sql scope image rows/references to fixed workspace; no durable many-to-many project ownership/global-public access record is present. No physical asset GC is implemented (README.md, V74_STORAGE_HANDOFF.md). Project deletion in index.html:792-803 changes JSON snapshots only. Runtime behavior unverified.

findings.title: Image objects lack numbered editor-only labels
findings.detail: index.html:2085-2093 sets the initial image object name to 'تصویر جدید' for each added image instead of Image 1, Image 2, ... . index.html:1921-1925 renders object names in the inspector. No evidence of automatic printed image number; requested editor-only sequential labeling is not implemented.

findings.title: Page index prints in footer but cover-number visibility control not confirmed
findings.detail: index.html:1020-1046: preview maps active portfolio state.pages to paper(p,i+1), and legacy footer emits the index unconditionally via index. Per-portfolio sequence calculation is visible in source; no Show on First Page toggle or separate dynamic page-number element was identified. PDF uses browser print of the preview, but no runtime/PDF verification was performed.

findings.title: Page-only Once element types are not implemented in the inspected creation route
findings.detail: index.html:2085-2093 creates standard text/image/line/shape/circle types; searched entire file for Text Once/Image Once and relevant Once implementations. Only DOM addEventListener options {once:true} matched 'once'. This is evidence of missing page-only Once element functionality in inspected V77 source, not a runtime claim.

business_rules.title: Page-specific once elements
business_rules.detail: Text Once and Image Once are page-only, never master-template elements; deleting the owning page deletes them.

business_rules.title: Page-number position
business_rules.detail: Hiding number on cover must not renumber subsequent pages.

business_rules.title: Safe shared image deletion
business_rules.detail: Deleting a project cascades its portfolios, elements and ownership records, but preserves physical assets owned/referenced by another project. Delete physical file only when orphaned.

business_rules.title: Image source integrity
business_rules.detail: Edits are non-destructive and do not mutate original library asset.

business_rules.title: Permanent image ownership
business_rules.detail: Sharing project A's image with B creates independent irrevocable ownership for B, not another physical file. Either owner can reshare to C or make public. One owner cannot revoke another's ownership.

business_rules.title: Public image ownership
business_rules.detail: Using a public image does not automatically create project ownership; explicit add-to-library action is required. Public images cannot be made private.

business_rules.title: Deletion integrity
business_rules.detail: Direct deletion of an image referenced by a page, portfolio or template is prohibited even for administrators. Removing an unused asset from one project's library affects only that ownership. Cascade deletion of a project/portfolio removes its own dependent records and garbage-collects only orphaned assets.

business_rules.title: Master template deletion
business_rules.detail: Block deletion of a master template while any portfolio depends on it; identify the dependent projects/portfolios and require removal of dependencies first.

business_rules.title: Inherited element controls
business_rules.detail: Inherited elements permit only local visibility toggle and z-order rearrangement; position, size, style and content remain locked. Page-created elements are independently editable.

business_rules.title: Live master propagation
business_rules.detail: All master changes immediately propagate to dependent portfolios, even when overlapping page content. Where feasible, flag dependent portfolios as requiring review until acknowledged; do not block propagation.

business_rules.title: Portfolio page isolation
business_rules.detail: Page numbering restarts independently for each portfolio. Pages cannot be transferred between portfolios; deleting a page cascades its owned page elements.

business_rules.title: Image object labels are not printed numbers
business_rules.detail: Image 1/Image 2 are editor identifiers for image objects. Each object references an image selected from the library via SQLite. No automatic image numbering appears in pages or PDF.

business_rules.title: Master edits versus schema migration
business_rules.detail: Editing a master template immediately updates dependent designs; it is not a data migration. Test data may be cleaned as needed, while future real saved content must be preserved across software/schema upgrades.

requirements.title: Project CRUD and document organization
requirements.detail: Create/open/rename projects; each project can contain multiple independent portfolios, covers, identity pages, and repeated data pages.

requirements.title: Library manager
requirements.detail: Albums, bulk import, thumbnails, metadata, search, deduplication, safe deletion, and global/project scopes.

requirements.title: Dockable library
requirements.detail: Dock panel alongside Layers/Properties, pin/unpin, select multiple assets, drag/drop to page.

requirements.title: Dynamic image tiles
requirements.detail: One image object expands using right/bottom plus controls and synchronized vertical/horizontal Properties; keep existing tile content and support undo.

requirements.title: Tile Count convention
requirements.detail: 0×1 = one; 0×2 = two horizontally; 1×2 = four in two rows. Vertical count represents extra rows, horizontal count number per row; confirm implementation matches latest owner instruction.

requirements.title: Non-destructive image editing
requirements.detail: Crop, zoom, pan, fit/fill, replace, rotate, flip, opacity, border, rounded/circle/polygon masks, brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, sepia, blur, sharpen, reset and print-quality warning; per-tile settings.

requirements.title: Automatic page number
requirements.detail: Dynamic element, page order updates after insert/delete/reorder; option Show on First Page defaults off, without renumbering remaining pages; consistent preview/PDF.

requirements.title: Editor-only image object labels and library binding
requirements.detail: Adding an image object gives it an editor-only name (Image 1, Image 2, etc.). The user assigns a library image to that object, persisted as a SQLite asset reference. No automatic visible image numbering, number overlays or printed image captions are required in page preview or PDF.

requirements.title: Text Once and Image Once
requirements.detail: Text Once and Image Once may only be created on individual pages, never in master templates; deleting their owning page cascades those elements; pages cannot be transferred between portfolios.

requirements.title: Repeat and inheritance controls
requirements.detail: Live inheritance: every inherited line/text/image/other element is locked for geometry, content and style; child may change only its visibility true/false and stacking order (z-index). Newly created child objects retain independent properties. Master updates propagate immediately even with overlaps; optional reviewed-change warning.

requirements.title: Image library persistence
requirements.detail: Store a single immutable physical file per asset in images/; SQLite manages ownership, access and references. No direct source replacement. Deletion of physical file only when no remaining ownership or active references; missing files display an unavailable-source placeholder.

decisions.title: Project-first organization
decisions.detail: Project is primary workspace and contains independent portfolios. Templates are defined in a centralized system-wide template library, independent of projects and portfolios.

decisions.title: Multiple portfolios per project
decisions.detail: A project can contain multiple independent portfolios/catalogs; default names Portfolio 1, Portfolio 2, editable.

decisions.title: Project and global libraries
decisions.detail: One physical image per asset in server-side images/ beside index.html; SQLite stores independent project ownership records and public visibility. Sharing grants permanent independent ownership without duplicating bytes; any owner may reshare or publish.

decisions.title: Preserve master/page inheritance
decisions.detail: System-wide Master Templates -> Page Templates -> portfolio pages. Live inheritance propagates master changes immediately. Inherited elements are locked except local visibility true/false and z-order positioning; local page-created elements have their own properties.

decisions.title: Desktop evolution
decisions.detail: Use Tauri 2 and SQLite; preserve existing behavior and migrate incrementally.

decisions.title: No tests or builds by assistant
decisions.detail: Do not run build or tests; user owns runtime review.

decisions.title: Current development/test data may be reset during schema restructuring
decisions.detail: Owner explicitly authorizes discarding or rebuilding the CURRENT test-stage saved data if this simplifies the architecture. This does not authorize loss of future real user data, destruction of repository source history, or claims that any reset was actually run.

decisions.title: Locked-layer grouping and master inheritance
decisions.detail: Locked ordinary objects may be grouped without unlocking. Group movement or resizing is prohibited when it would violate a child lock. Ungroup preserves child lock states. Inherited master objects cannot be transformed or re-owned through grouping.

decisions.title: Page save and project save are separate
decisions.detail: Save Page / Ctrl+S saves only the current design page; Save Project explicitly saves pending changes across the portfolio. Neither should silently substitute for the other.

decisions.title: Style Library is exclusively central
decisions.detail: Owner explicitly rejected project-specific styles. A single central shared Style Library applies across all projects, with no project-local style definitions or overrides.

decisions.title: History lasts only for current editing session
decisions.detail: Undo/Redo and History records are session-scoped and need not survive closing/restarting the application. Saved design changes remain persistent. Zoom and pan do not enter history.

UI project switching uses the global catalog; inherited object edits are restricted to local visibility and z-order. Asset ownership remains TASK-007. No builds/tests/runtime acceptance.

tasks.detail: Build SOL-003: stable assets, many-to-many permanent project ownership, public catalog, usage references across templates/pages/tiles/backups, safe cascading deletes, independent per-project browsing. Resolve storage-root portability vs Tauri app-local root; do not enable unsafe physical garbage collection.

Asset files remain immutable and physical garbage collection is disabled. Source not built or runtime verified; owner acceptance pending.

tasks.title: PDF and office-print preflight
tasks.detail: Validate text overflow, page bounds, missing images, A4/A3 paper settings and configurable safe printable margins; clickable errors locate affected objects; PDF preview. No bleed, crop marks or mandatory CMYK.

tasks.title: Smart guides and snapping
tasks.detail: Design-page-only movable horizontal/vertical guides, numeric positions in mm, Show/Hide toolbar control without deleting guides, object snapping, persistent positions, no PDF output and no master inheritance.

tasks.title: Region Block container
tasks.detail: Toolbar creates sequential Block 1/2; nested editable image/text/shape children move together, collapsible Layers node, container-only or proportional-content resize modes; Ctrl-resize from center applies globally, independently of aspect ratio lock.

tasks.title: Advanced Layers panel
tasks.detail: Rename, reorder, multi-select, visibility and ordinary-object locks; collapsible Region Blocks and Groups; inherited master objects retain immutable placement/style and permit only visibility/z-order overrides.

tasks.title: History panel and Undo/Redo
tasks.detail: Right-side History tab alongside Layers and Properties, clickable operation timeline, undo/redo shortcuts, at least 100 page-local steps, atomic block/group edits. Zoom and pan excluded. History is SESSION-ONLY and is cleared on application close/restart; saved page content persists independently.

tasks.title: Design toolbar and zoom/pan
tasks.detail: Top toolbar Save Page (Ctrl+S, current page only), Save Project (all changed pages, separate explicit action), Print, Undo/Redo, Cut/Copy/Paste, Zoom, Pan, Fit Page and Show/Hide Guides. Display save success/errors and dirty-page state.

tasks.title: Style Library
tasks.detail: Word-like linked named styles for text, colors and optionally frames. ONE CENTRAL SHARED STYLE LIBRARY ONLY, available to every project; no project-specific style definitions, overrides or forks. Style updates propagate to linked objects without altering geometry or master ownership.

tasks.title: Group/Ungroup distinct from Region Block
tasks.detail: Group ordinary objects with Layers folder/chain affordance; Ungroup preserves child locks; locked objects may join groups without unlocking; block group transforms that would move/resize locked children; never bypass master inheritance or alter Region Block ownership.

current_architecture.note: V79 source includes logical per-project image ownership, permanent public assets and usage/backup reference tracking; all persistent bytes remain in writable Tauri app-local storage/assets; no physical GC. Runtime behavior not yet verified. V78 project/template model also unverified.
